name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Senior Software Engineer in Test | Backend & Automation
summary: Software engineer with 25+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise applications, with hands-on experience in automated testing, backend APIs, and service-based systems. Collaborated on Cucumber BDD and end-to-end integration tests, established test practices with Zephyr, and championed unit testing and code quality. Brings strong Java, C#, .NET, SQL, and CI/CD experience to improving software quality across distributed, cloud-hosted environments.
